Automatic Reimbursement Actuals

For expense lines marked Requires Reimbursement, UnitedBML reads the actual bill amount directly from the related reimbursement case and AP batches. No duplicate settlement entry is required.

Procurement Pre-Approval Email

Review the email and approved Expense Approval Note before sending to Procurement.
Required attachment: Approved Expense Note.pdf
UnitedBML will generate the approved Expense Approval Note PDF and send it as a real attachment through the configured Gmail account.
This email covers all reimbursement expense lines under the Expense Request in one Procurement approval. Once approved, UnitedBML creates separate line-wise reimbursement cases for tracking and AP submission.

Record Procurement Response

Automatically populated from the Procurement email recipient(s) used for the original pre-approval.
No response email attached.
Attach the Procurement reply as Outlook MSG, EML, PDF or an image. Maximum 15 MB.
